name: CC BY 4.0 (Attribution)
definition: Allows sharing and adapting for any purpose, including commercial, with attribution.

name: CC BY-SA 4.0 (Attribution-ShareAlike)
definition: Allows sharing and adapting, including commercial,  if adaptations use the same license.

name: CC BY-NC 4.0 (Attribution-NonCommercial)
definition: Allows sharing and adapting for non-commercial purposes only.

name: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike)
definition: Allows non-commercial sharing and adapting if adaptations use the same license.

name: CC BY-ND 4.0 (Attribution-NoDerivatives)
definition: Allows sharing (including commercial) in unchanged form only; no derivative adaptations.

name: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 (Attribution-NonCommercial-NoDerivatives)
definition: Most restrictive; allows non-commercial sharing of unchanged work only.
